title: 最大的幻方
summary: 求网格中最大的正方形，使其每行、每列以及两条对角线元素和全部相等。
insight: 预处理每行和每列的前缀和，能 O(1) 取得候选方形的任一行列和；按边长从大到小枚举，逐行列并计算两条对角线验证，首个成功即答案。

solutions.title: 降序边长与行列前缀校验
solutions.idea: 优先验证最大候选并快速求各行列和。
steps: size 从 min(rows,cols) 降到 1，枚举左上角
以首行和为 target，检查全部行列及两条对角线；成功返回 size

code.java: class Solution { public int largestMagicSquare(int[][] grid){int rows=grid.length,cols=grid[0].length;int[][] rowPrefix=new int[rows][cols+1],colPrefix=new int[rows+1][cols];for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)for(int c=0;c<cols;c++){rowPrefix[r][c+1]=rowPrefix[r][c]+grid[r][c];colPrefix[r+1][c]=colPrefix[r][c]+grid[r][c];}for(int size=Math.min(rows,cols);size>=1;size--)for(int top=0;top+size<=rows;top++)for(int left=0;left+size<=cols;left++){int target=rowPrefix[top][left+size]-rowPrefix[top][left];boolean valid=true;for(int offset=0;offset<size&&valid;offset++)valid=rowPrefix[top+offset][left+size]-rowPrefix[top+offset][left]==target&&colPrefix[top+size][left+offset]-colPrefix[top][left+offset]==target;int first=0,second=0;for(int offset=0;offset<size;offset++){first+=grid[top+offset][left+offset];second+=grid[top+offset][left+size-1-offset];}if(valid&&first==target&&second==target)return size;}return 1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun largestMagicSquare(grid:Array<IntArray>):Int{val rows=grid.size;val cols=grid[0].size;val rowPrefix=Array(rows){IntArray(cols+1)};val colPrefix=Array(rows+1){IntArray(cols)};for(r in 0 until rows)for(c in 0 until cols){rowPrefix[r][c+1]=rowPrefix[r][c]+grid[r][c];colPrefix[r+1][c]=colPrefix[r][c]+grid[r][c]};for(size in minOf(rows,cols) downTo 1)for(top in 0..rows-size)for(left in 0..cols-size){val target=rowPrefix[top][left+size]-rowPrefix[top][left];var valid=true;for(offset in 0 until size)if(rowPrefix[top+offset][left+size]-rowPrefix[top+offset][left]!=target||colPrefix[top+size][left+offset]-colPrefix[top][left+offset]!=target){valid=false;break};var first=0;var second=0;for(offset in 0 until size){first+=grid[top+offset][left+offset];second+=grid[top+offset][left+size-1-offset]};if(valid&&first==target&&second==target)return size};return 1} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int largestMagicSquare(vector<vector<int>>& grid){int rows=grid.size(),cols=grid[0].size();vector<vector<int>> row(rows,vector<int>(cols+1)),col(rows+1,vector<int>(cols));for(int r=0;r<rows;++r)for(int c=0;c<cols;++c){row[r][c+1]=row[r][c]+grid[r][c];col[r+1][c]=col[r][c]+grid[r][c];}for(int size=min(rows,cols);size>=1;--size)for(int top=0;top+size<=rows;++top)for(int left=0;left+size<=cols;++left){int target=row[top][left+size]-row[top][left];bool valid=true;for(int offset=0;offset<size&&valid;++offset)valid=row[top+offset][left+size]-row[top+offset][left]==target&&col[top+size][left+offset]-col[top][left+offset]==target;int first=0,second=0;for(int offset=0;offset<size;++offset){first+=grid[top+offset][left+offset];second+=grid[top+offset][left+size-1-offset];}if(valid&&first==target&&second==target)return size;}return 1;} };
